_comment: 3-tier token structure: primitive -> semantic -> component. Fill primitives from the client's brand (or extracted from their live site), derive semantic roles from primitives, derive component tokens from semantic roles. Never let generated code reference a primitive or a raw hex directly.

font.display: REPLACE - deliberate pairing, never Inter alone

button.bg-primary-hover: REPLACE - do not reuse the default value, define the hover state explicitly
button.radius: REPLACE - state the actual value, e.g. pill (999px) or square (0px), never leave to default

card.border: REPLACE - state border-only vs shadow-based explicitly, do not default to shadow-md

_enforcement_reminder: Ship a lint (or at minimum a manual grep pass: rg 'bg-\[#|text-\[#|p-\[[0-9]' src/) that fails on any raw hex/px value outside this file. Component-generation prompts must resolve everything through semantic/component tokens, never primitives directly.
